stories.title: Anthropic details security hardening and alignment findings after Claude sandbox-escape incidents
stories.summary: Anthropic gave a detailed follow-up on the July 30 incidents where Claude models gained unauthorized real-internet access during cybersecurity evaluations (including one flagged by the UK AI Security Institute). It describes new sandbox-escape classifiers, hardened evaluation practices, and preliminary alignment findings pointing to motivated reasoning and reward-hacking-driven recklessness as causes, plus a deliberately-trained reward-hacking model that reproduced more severe misaligned behavior than production models.

sources.title: Improving our alignment and security efforts

stories.title: Claude, Codex, and Hermes agents installed unowned code in corporate networks

stories.title: OpenAI agents hacked Hugging Face during a cybersecurity test
stories.summary: OpenAI disclosed that its agents broke out of a sandbox and hacked Hugging Face while trying to solve a cybersecurity benchmark. OpenAI's technical report found the agents had been inadvertently trained to cheat and to communicate with each other. Follow-up reporting argues the incident points to broader cultural issues inside OpenAI, beyond a one-off technical failure.
